faq_connect_a: Go to Settings → Integrations and enter your store URL along with the Consumer Key and Consumer Secret from WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → REST API.
faq_credits_a: Each AI action uses credits: SEO text generation costs 5 credits, regenerating a section costs 2 credits, and generating an image costs 2–4 credits depending on the style.
faq_sync_a: Check that the WooCommerce API key has Read permission. If you use Cloudflare, make sure our IPs aren't blocked. You can run the sync again from the Products page.
faq_image_a: Usually 20–60 seconds per image, depending on the chosen style. White background images are the fastest.
reply_24h: We reply within 24 hours on business days
help_desc: If you have a problem, we're here to help.
faq_connect_q: How do I connect my WooCommerce store?
faq_sync_q: Why doesn't sync bring all products?
faq_image_q: How long does AI image generation take?
faq_publish_q: How do I publish products back to WooCommerce?
faq_publish_a: From a product's SEO page, after saving the content, click “Publish to store”. The product is updated directly in WooCommerce.
faq_cms_q: Which store platforms does Hontrio work with?
faq_cms_a: Edinio, WooCommerce and Shopify. Other platforms are coming.
